Your first $10,000 in crypto.
Every step. Nothing at stake.

Real life has no practice mode — this is it. The money starts on a bank card and you carry it the whole way: onto an exchange, into your own wallet, across networks, into coins and memes. Real fees, real gas, real slippage. Fake money.

Free forever. Email sign-in, no password, no deposit — nothing to lose but bad habits.
01 · BANKThe card$10,000 lands on a virtual Visa. Link it to the exchange and feel the 1.8% card fee — your first lesson.

03 · ON-CHAINYour wallet & the memesGenerate addresses, guard a seed phrase, pick a network, pay gas in SOL — and hunt 150+ live meme coins on 4 chains.
Fees are the curriculum. Card 1.8%, exchange 0.1%, DEX 0.3%, network fees $0.80-$8, gas per transaction.
Seed phrase moment. Shown once, never stored — exactly how self-custody works.
